title: Jubilant Creamy Ethiopian Natto Onigiri
description: A floral and creamy Ethiopian dish featuring natto, shaped into nigiri and perfect for a keto-friendly brunch, this recipe combines unique flavors for a delightful meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soften the cream cheese in the microwave for 10 seconds.
Mix the softened cream cheese with lemon juice, garlic, and berbere spice in a bowl.
Add the natto to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Cut the injera bread into small squares.
Place a small amount of the natto mixture onto the center of each injera square.
Fold the injera squares into triangles to form onigiri shapes.
Brush the tops of the onigiri with ghee.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and scallions on top of the onigiri.
Place the onigiri on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 10 minutes.
